ios.desc:
Keyboard Warrior is a 60 second speed typing game where you must type as many words before they disappear off screen. Type the word and hit the spacebar or next key to type another word. Do not make typos! Beat the highest scores on the global leaderboard and become the fastest typer in the world!

There are 7 levels of increasing difficulty. 

The "Easy" level consists of the top 250 common english words like I, him, her, me, night, here, money etc.

The "Medium" level consists of the top 3000 most common english words. These are usually longer than the Easy ones.

The more complex levels consist of alphanumerics, punctuations, random characters, case-sensitive words and so on.

After finishing a game, you can see an interactive graph of the words which you got right or wrong and tap on them to see how long you took to type the words. You also get to know your WPM (Words per minute) and KPM (Keys per minute).

The game doesn't contain any ads. I hope this game helps you improve your typing speed.

If you have any feedback, please send it to:
pran@pranapps.com

quotes.text:
Download: https://itunes.apple.com/ca/app/keyboard-warrior-speed-typing/id1435547020?mt=8

Hi everyone,

I built a speed typing game for iPhone inspired by the many desktop alternatives for testing your typing speeds.

The concept is quite simple. You have 60 seconds to type as many words as possible. After each word, hit the spacebar or next key to type the next word. You will know your WPM (Words per minute) and KPM (Keys per minute) once the time is over.

There are 7 levels in the game. The easy one consists of the top 250 most common english words. The hard level consists of 3000 most common words. The next difficult levels consist of capitalization, numbers, punctuations, random characters and so on. The game has a global leaderboard too where you can see where you rank.

I was inspired by someone's side-project on reddit: 
https://www.reddit.com/r/SideProject/comments/9ckogk/crazy_typer_a_game_inspired_by_typing_tests/?st=jm80a7j7&sh=978e8389
 and thought of building something similar for iOS.

Without further ado, I would love for you to try Keyboard Warrior:

https://itunes.apple.com/ca/app/keyboard-warrior-speed-typing/id1435547020?mt=8

Android app is also in development and planning on releasing sometime this week. Any questions and feedback are welcome!
